verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken banner with the product mirrored to the other side. In each, the headline is huge, while the CTA 'Build Your Mix', the five botanical chips and the legal copy are shrunk to unreadable micro-text in one cramped bottom row, so the CTA is buried and the hierarchy is inverted. A is slightly worse: the legal block is jammed between the last chip and the product can, and the can crowds the right and bottom edges. B's can sits with clearer breathing room on the left, though its tiny legal text floats awkwardly at the far right.
